name: Reviewer, Not Data-Entry Clerk
description: Understand what AI clinical coding pipelines do, what they get wrong, and what the human reviewer is actually for.

name: Validating Against Real Standards
description: Check records against HL7, FHIR, terminology and privacy requirements — for logic, not just for completeness.

name: Catching What the AI Misses
description: Recognise, by pattern, the encounters where automated coding is most likely to be confidently wrong.

name: Patient Safety Auditing
description: Audit AI-assisted clinical systems for safety-critical failure and write findings both clinical and engineering teams can act on.

name: Working at Volume
description: Sustain accuracy and speed across a real queue, with real quality measurement and real fatigue.

name: Getting and Keeping the Work
description: Get hired into an AI-oversight coding role and keep it sustainably, remote and at variable capacity.
